Notation: \(R\) = number primary replicate columns \(R_C\) = number control replicate columns \(\) = primary_design@variables$scale (scalar replication constant) \(A_C\) = control_design@variables$scale \(\hat{t}_{Cx}\) = control full-sample estimated totals variables \(\hat{t}_{Cx}^{(r)}\) = control replicate-\(r\) estimated totals \(T_{\text{fixed}}\) = fixed population margins targets (empty set targets = NULL) Step 1. Extract \(\), \(A_C\), \(R\), \(R_C\). Step 2. Compute expansion factor: \(R_C > R\), set \(K = \lceil R_C / R \rceil\), \(R_{\text{eff}} = K R\), \(A_{\text{eff}} = / K\); otherwise \(K = 1\), \(R_{\text{eff}} = R\), \(A_{\text{eff}} = \). Step 3. Compute adjustment constants: $$a_r = \begin{cases}     \sqrt{A_C / A_{\text{eff}}} & r = 1, \ldots, \min(R_{\text{eff}}, R_C) \\     0                           & r > \min(R_{\text{eff}}, R_C)   \end{cases}$$ \(K = 1\) reduces \(\sqrt{A_C / }\). Step 4. Compute full-sample control totals \(\hat{t}_{Cx}\) per-replicate control totals \(\hat{t}_{Cx}^{(r)}\) variable variables. Step 5. Draw random mapping control replicate columns virtual primary replicates. One permutation drawn per call; use set.seed() calling make results reproducible. Step 6. Calibrate full-sample weights primary_design combined target set \(\{ \hat{t}_{Cx} \}\) (random margins) union \(T_{\text{fixed}}\) (fixed margins). defines \(w_i^*\). Step 7. primary replicate \(r = 1, \ldots, R\): virtual replicate \(s\) \(K\) repetitions replicate \(r\), compute perturbed control total: $$\hat{t}^*_{Cx}(s) =     \hat{t}_{Cx} + a_s \bigl(\hat{t}^{(c_s)}_{Cx} - \hat{t}_{Cx}\bigr)$$ \(c_s\) mapped control replicate virtual replicate \(s\). Retained units stratum h scaled n_h / (n_h - 1); units strata unchanged: $$   w_{k(hi)} = \begin{cases}     0 & \text{unit } k \text{ PSU } \text{ stratum } h \\     \dfrac{n_h}{n_h - 1}\, w_k & \text{unit } k \text{ stratum } h,\; k \neq \\     w_k & \text{unit } k \text{ stratum } h   \end{cases} $$ mse = TRUE variance estimator (Wolter 2007 eq. 4.6.4a): $$   v_J(\hat{\theta}) = \sum_{h=1}^{H} \frac{n_h - 1}{n_h}     \sum_{=1}^{n_h} \left( \hat{\theta}_{(hi)} - \hat{\theta} \right)^2 $$ Total replicates = \(\sum_h n_h\) (one per PSU across strata). JK1 (unstratified delete-one jackknife) Special case JKn treating PSUs single stratum (Valliant, Dever & Kreuter 2018 §15.4.1 "Special Cases"). Scale factor (n-1)/n; total replicates = n. text: MLE — pseudo-likelihood score equation (Chen, Li & Wu, 2020; Beresewicz et al., 2025, eq. 3.1): $$U_{MLE}(\gamma) = \sum_{k \NPS} x_k - \sum_{k \ref} d_k \pi_k(\gamma) x_k = 0$$ \(\pi_k(\gamma) = \text{link}^{-1}(x_k^\top \gamma)\) propensity score link function method. system solved Newton-Raphson step \(\gamma_{t+1} = \gamma_t - H^{-1} U\), \(H = -X_{ref}^\top \text{diag}(d \pi(1-\pi)) X_{ref}\) Hessian. IPW weights \(w_k = 1 / \pi_k(\hat\gamma)\) — reciprocal estimated participation propensity. convergence, weighted NPS covariate totals match reference totals expectation. GEE — calibration estimating equations (Beresewicz et al., 2025, eq. 3.3): $$U_{GEE}(\gamma) = \sum_{k \NPS} \frac{x_k}{\pi_k(\gamma)} - \sum_{k \ref} d_k x_k = 0$$ convergence, guarantees exact covariate balance: \(\sum_k w_k x_k = \sum_k d_k x_k\). system solved nleqslv::nleqslv() analytical Jacobian \(J(\gamma) = -X_{NPS}^\top \text{diag}((1-\pi)/\pi) X_{NPS}\) Newton method double-dogleg global strategy. Convergence declared nleqslv termination code 1 (function criterion near zero) 2 (step criterion near zero). IPW weights \(w_k = 1 / \pi_k(\hat\gamma)\).
